shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml && cat package.json"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "specs/.+#|spec:" src/**/*.test.ts | head -80 && ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true && git log -3 --oneline && git status -sb'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,210p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && rg -n \"specs/.*#[0-9]+|spec anchor|@spec|SPEC\" src scripts | head -120 && rg -n \"descriptor.*spec|spec:\" scripts/lore-* scripts/check-spec*"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,150p' && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --runInBand && git diff --check && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "Cache dynamic tool schema validators" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb'
